 Giants encourage fans to wear white for Thursday Night Football
 Nov 09, 2026 at 02:00 PM Giants.com 
 Copied! 
 The New York Giants are calling on fans to help create a "White Out" environment at MetLife Stadium when they take on the Washington Commanders on Thursday Night Football, Nov. 12 at 8:15 p.m.
 The Giants are set to wear their "Vintage White" uniforms and fans are strongly encouraged to wear white to the game to "White Out" MetLife Stadium. All attendees will receive a rally towel along with wearable light bands, which will be used for coordinated stadium-wide displays throughout the game. Fans are encouraged to arrive early and be in their seats by 7:45 p.m. for special player introductions, fireworks and a laser show.
 "White Out" Shop (Nov. 11 at MetLife Stadium)
 The Giants are providing fans with an opportunity to gear up for gameday by visiting the "White Out" Shop, featuring a limited edition "White Out" collection from Starter along with other apparel such as the "Vintage White" jerseys. Located outside MetLife Stadium between the MetLife and Verizon Gates.
 MORE INFO The Giants are also providing fans with an opportunity to gear up for gameday by visiting the "White Out" Shop, featuring a limited edition "White Out" collection from Starter along with other apparel including the "Vintage White" jerseys. The shop will be open for early access on Wednesday, Nov. 11 from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. outside MetLife Stadium between the MetLife and Verizon Gates. Parking for the Wednesday shop is free in Lot F, and no parking pass is required.
 Additional "White Out" apparel will also be available on gameday inside MetLife Stadium at the Starter plaza activation and in the Flagship Store, presented by American Express, when gates open at 6:15 p.m.
 The primetime outing, presented by Verizon, will be the second matchup between the NFC East rivals this season after the two teams finished in a 27-27 tie in Week 5. Thursday's matchup will also be the second divisional primetime game at MetLife Stadium this season following the Giants' 28-20 victory over the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday Night Football in the season opener.
